# LLMention GEO Scanner

> LLMention GEO Scanner is an independent Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
> readiness audit, not a mention tracker: it checks whether AI search engines and
> LLM crawlers can access, parse and cite a website, and it generates the /llms.txt
> context file those crawlers may read.

LLMention is a free web tool for developers, SEO teams and marketing teams who
need to know whether their site is readable by generative search engines such as
ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. It reports crawl blocks,
missing context files and structural issues that stop a page from being quoted in
an AI-generated answer, and produces a shareable readiness score.

It is unrelated to DataForSEO's LLM Mentions API: that product measures brand
mentions, which is a different measurement, and there is no partnership, data
relationship or shared operator between the two.

## Core capabilities

- [AI Crawler Passability](https://llmention-geo.com/): Scans robots.txt
  and WAF rules to verify that GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bytespider and
  other AI crawler user-agents are not blocked.
- [Answer Checker](https://llmention-geo.com/answer-check/): Applies six published
  rules to an answer you paste from ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini - whether the
  brand is mentioned, mentioned early, listed, recommended, and which domains the
  answer cites. Runs in the browser, contacts no AI engine, and gives a count
  rather than a score out of 100.
- [llms.txt Studio](https://llmention-geo.com/llms-txt-studio/): Generates
  a standardized markdown context file so LLMs can digest a domain's content
  cleanly, ready to deploy at the domain root.
- [Readiness Badge](https://llmention-geo.com/readiness-badge/): Produces
  an embeddable real-time GEO readiness badge for GitHub READMEs and site footers.
- [Weekly GEO report](https://llmention-geo.com/monitor/): The same checks re-run
  once a week, emailed as a diff that names the rules which newly fail, with the
  evidence each failing check saw.
- [Scan API](https://llmention-geo.com/api-docs/): The public, keyless JSON endpoint
  behind every scan - the same analyser, documented parameters, response fields and
  best-effort rate limit. The published study was collected through it.

## Documentation

- [Methodology](https://llmention-geo.com/methodology/): The complete scoring
  method - twelve weighted dimensions, every check with its exact rule, the A-F
  grade bands, the primary research behind the weighting, and a statement of what
  the score cannot tell you. Generated from the same data the analyser runs on.
- [GEO knowledge hub](https://llmention-geo.com/docs/): Index of all guides.
- [How to check whether AI engines mention your brand](https://llmention-geo.com/docs/ai-visibility-self-check/):
  Twenty questions to ask an engine yourself, the six mechanical checks for scoring
  an answer, and why one run is an anecdote rather than a measurement.
- [How to generate and deploy an llms.txt file](https://llmention-geo.com/docs/llms-txt-deployment/):
  File format, hosting location, verification steps, and an honest assessment of
  what llms.txt does and does not do for AI visibility.
- [Configuring robots.txt and WAF for GPTBot and PerplexityBot](https://llmention-geo.com/docs/allow-ai-crawlers/):
  Which user-agents AI search engines send, and how to stop a firewall from
  silently returning 403 to them.
- [Optimizing headings for direct AI citation](https://llmention-geo.com/docs/qa-style-headings/):
  Rewriting H2 and H3 headings as real questions and pairing them with
  answer-first paragraphs.
- [Implementing Schema.org JSON-LD for entity disambiguation](https://llmention-geo.com/docs/schema-org-jsonld/):
  Connecting Organization, WebSite and SoftwareApplication nodes into one entity.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://llmention-geo.com/pricing/): What stays free - the scanner, the
  published checks and the weekly report for one domain - and what the paid
  measurement work costs: a Signal report at $39, and a Pro report at $99 with a
  second engine and one retest of the same question bank within 90 days.

## Comparisons

- [Which measurement do you need?](https://llmention-geo.com/compare/): Readiness
  audits, brand-mention tracking, rank tracking and crawler-log analytics side by
  side - the question each answers, the data each needs, and what each cannot see.
- [LLMention GEO Scanner vs DataForSEO's LLM Mentions API](https://llmention-geo.com/compare/llm-mentions-api/):
  Two similarly named products that measure different things. The two are
  unaffiliated, and neither replaces the other; the page says what each does, with
  DataForSEO's own description and the date it was read.
- [Can AI cite you, or is it already doing so?](https://llmention-geo.com/compare/readiness-vs-mention-tracking/):
  Why readiness is upstream of mentions, why a page can be ready and still go
  unmentioned, and how to audit first and monitor second.

## Machine-readable

- [Homepage as markdown](https://llmention-geo.com/markdown/): A markdown twin of
  the homepage for engines that parse text more cheaply than HTML. It mirrors the
  homepage - same sections, same claims - rather than being a second version of it.

## Writing

- [All writing](https://llmention-geo.com/blog/): First-party pieces on what the
  30-site study found, how the rules fail in practice, and where the method is weaker
  than it looks.
- [We scanned 30 homepages and none graded an A](https://llmention-geo.com/blog/thirty-homepages-none-graded-a/):
  The full grade distribution, the ceiling, and why the average is taken over the 21
  homepages that answered rather than all 30.
- [Six news publishers, six blocking AI crawlers](https://llmention-geo.com/blog/six-news-publishers-blocking-ai-crawlers/):
  Every news site in the sample turns away at least one tracked crawler; the measured
  status codes and the policy trade behind them.
- [Nine homepages never answered the crawler](https://llmention-geo.com/blog/nine-homepages-never-answered/):
  What a 401, 403, 429, 202 or 520 means for a score, and why those rows are published
  and excluded from the mean.
- [22 of 30 sites leave AI guessing who they are](https://llmention-geo.com/blog/entity-markup-gap/):
  The entity and sameAs coverage across the sample, with the smallest JSON-LD graph that
  passes both rules.
- [llms.txt: what the evidence actually supports](https://llmention-geo.com/blog/llms-txt-what-the-evidence-supports/):
  Why the convention is checked, why it is capped at 3.3 of 100 points, and what the
  crawler documentation does and does not commit to.
- [How to read a failed check and fix the right thing](https://llmention-geo.com/blog/reading-a-failed-check/):
  The three questions to ask before editing, and the difference between satisfying a rule
  and satisfying the reason it exists.

## Company

- [About](https://llmention-geo.com/about/): Who maintains the tool, what it
  deliberately does not do, and how to report a result you believe is wrong.
- [Who writes this site](https://llmention-geo.com/author/): The person accountable for
  the measurements, how the writing is produced and corrected, and how the site is
  funded.
- [Study](https://llmention-geo.com/study/): First-party measurements over 30
  major homepages, published with the sample and the date they were taken.
- [Self-audit](https://llmention-geo.com/self-audit/): This site measured by its own
  scanner: the score, the date it was taken, and the evidence behind every check,
  published rather than quoted.

## Contact and legal

- [Contact](https://llmention-geo.com/contact/): One email address for score
  corrections and data requests.
- [Privacy policy](https://llmention-geo.com/privacy/): What a scan processes,
  what the server logs contain, how advertising cookies are handled, and how to
  exercise your data rights.
- [Terms of service](https://llmention-geo.com/terms/): What is promised, what
  is not, and what you may and may not scan.

## Supported AI crawlers

GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User (OpenAI); ClaudeBot, Claude-User,
Claude-SearchBot, anthropic-ai (Anthropic); PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User
(Perplexity); Google-Extended (Google); Applebot-Extended (Apple); Bytespider
(ByteDance); CCBot (Common Crawl); meta-externalagent (Meta).

## Notes

- Last updated 2026-10-23. This file is maintained by hand, not generated, so it
  must be regenerated whenever a route is added or renamed; generating it at build
  time is the intended fix.
- The scanner and the llms.txt generator are free and do not require an account.
- Scan result pages under /report/ are generated per request and are excluded from
  search indexing via robots.txt.
- The tool is maintained by one independent developer, named on the author page,
  and is reachable at services@llmention-geo.com.
